score: 1 - (dist-dmin)/(dmax-dmin) where dist = |R1ak − line(R1ps,R/2)|; 1 = most colinear in this window (≈ critical line), 0 = least in this window
layout: row-major T (slow) × sigma (fast): index = jT * nSigma + iSigma
